purpose: Text action control for primary, secondary, subtle, danger, and ghost actions.

guidance.useWhen: Use for primary business actions such as Save, Submit, Create, or Cancel.
guidance.avoidWhen: Avoid for repeated icon-only utilities; use IconButton or ToolbarButton instead.
guidance.aiUsageNotes: Use visible text for important actions.

limitations: Avoid for repeated icon-only utilities; use IconButton or ToolbarButton instead.

accessibility.notes: Button renders a native button and supports disabled/loading states.

examples.title: Primary action
examples.intent: Show a visible-text primary action using the shared Button contract.

examples.title: Action emphasis
examples.intent: Compare the supported default, primary, subtle, ghost, and danger action emphasis without inventing application-specific variants.

examples.title: Busy and disabled states
examples.intent: Demonstrate the shared disabled and loading action states while keeping workflow state application-owned.
